alex: Repro for quantized-13b-int4 when using long prefills. At ~token 2048 we see duplicated tokens immediately after a KV refill. Minimal repro attached in thread.

mira: Can you paste the exact run command and seed?

alex: Sure — this is the command I used:
```
python reproduce.py --model magnet-13b-int4 --quant int4 --prompt-file tests/long_prefill.txt --seed 42 --max-length 4096 --stream-prefill
```

devon: Quick read of logs suggests a RoPE phase misalignment on concat between system prompt + long user prompt. Here's the snippet where tokens start repeating:
```
[INFO] gen: token_idx=2047 token="the"
[INFO] refill: kv_window_end=2047
[INFO] gen: token_idx=2048 token="the"  <-- duplicate
```

sam: I ran the same sequence on float16 and int8 builds — duplication only appears on the int4 path. So likely quant path or int4 kernel rounding.

alex: Additional detail: happens only when we do prefix insertion after an already-warmed prefill (i.e., prefill stream -> insert session metadata -> continue generate). If we run without prefix insertion we don't hit it.

mira: Hypothesis: rotary scaling computed from absolute positions is getting truncated/rounded differently in the quantized kernels during prefill vs live generate, producing an off-by-one phase for keys stored across the refill boundary. That would cause mismatch in cached KV attention leading to repeated token sampling.

devon: I added a quick KV checksum print to the debug harness: `kv_sha1 = sha1(kv_view.cpu().numpy().tobytes())`. On the run: before refill sha1="a1b2c3d4e5f6" after refill for the same logical positions sha1="c3d4e5f6a1b2". Divergence shows at logical pos 2049.

ci-bot: CI triggered for branch `rope-debug/kv-checks` — https://ci.internal/redwood/rope-debug/1234 (run queued)

mira: Weirdly, applying a tiny empirical scale tweak `--ropextra-scale=1.000976` removed the duplication in my local runs (int4). Not a fix but suggests numeric sensitivity.

sam: If tweaking scale avoids the symptom, we should still add a unit that exercises RoPE across shard boundaries and with odd prefill/generate transitions. I'll add `tests/long_rope_shard_boundary.py` to the eval harness.

devon: Observed on both single-gpu and Dedicated sharded runs; on Dedicated it tends to reproduce faster (fewer tokens) which points to interaction with sharded offsets.

alex: Filing bug tracker item now: BUG-3421 (magnet-13b-int4 ropescale/kv mismatch causing duplicate tokens at refill boundary). Assigning to @mira and @devon for initial triage.

mira: Proposed immediate mitigation for onboarding: disable int4 rollout for long-context customers (>=2k tokens) and default them to int8 while we root-cause. Also add the checksum test to nightly.

alex: Agreed. I'll update the onboarding checklist and add the fallback. I'll also attach the failing sample and full logs to the bug.

sam: Working on the test PR. Will include a small harness to simulate: prefill -> prefix insert -> refill -> compare token stream across quant vs fp16.

devon: Next steps: 1) bisect quant kernel (rounding/trunc offsets) 2) reproduce deterministic failure on CI 3) propose patch to normalize rotary phase computation in quant path.

alex: Thanks. Ping me when CI finishes. For visibility: @eng-ml on this thread. :thumbsup:
